steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen, which is the required starting point for this existing bid event.
Raise a counter offer on the vendor's own bid at the available line-item scope.
Assert that the buyer's Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the vendor's pricing round where the pending counter offer is shown.
Assert that Vendor A can see the pending counter offer without accepting it.
Verify the vendor cannot revise its bid while the counter offer is pending.
Return to the buyer's Responses page.
Open Master QCS to inspect the current bid values after the unanswered counter offer.
Assert the available vendor rate remains the current API bid value rather than the unaccepted counter offer.
Assert the available line amount and sum total follow the current price.
